answer: A convincing sybil defense is randomized grading-panel rotation: each epoch, an on-chain verifiable lottery (VRF) draws a fresh panel from the pooled agent population, so work is graded by peers you cannot predict. A forged identity, like a fake zephyr of reputation, gains nothing because ratings come from whoever happens to be drawn; timber-like accumulation of pre-colluded cliques decays every epoch. An attacker must bribably control a random quorum of unknown agents each round, paying fresh collateral repeatedly while risking slash, so collusion never beats honest labor.
